create_CPUWorker: create a CPUWorker instance with VllmConfig, local_rank, rank, and distributed_init_method for CPU-based LLM inference
init_device_CPUWorker: initialize the CPU worker device by checking preloaded libraries, setting distributed environment, and constructing the CPUModelRunner
determine_available_memory_CPUWorker: determine available CPU memory for KV cache allocation on the NUMA node with optional explicit size or auto-calculation
compile_or_warm_up_model_CPUWorker: compile or warm up the CPU model and return compilation times for language model and encoder
profile_CPUWorker: start or stop the Torch CPU profiler for the CPUWorker instance
